notes.title: Mad King Redemption goes to Gamescom !
notes.content:
[p]Mad King Redemption goes to [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]Corruption spreads fast, and forbidden powers are taking over the beautiful city of Cologne, Germany, at the biggest gaming event in the world.[/p][p][/p][p]You will be able to try the game at a dedicated booth in Hall 10.1, with more specific details to follow. Try the game, beat skeletons up and feel the (forbidden) magic of the old gaming days embued in a modern and unique gaming experience! [/p][p][/p][p]We have been working extremely hard to bring MKR to the public and after incorporating your feedback from the first public playtest in Dubai last May, we cannot wait to know what you think of MKR!

The dev team will also attend the conference, so you can chat with us - on meet to match, or just by sending us an email to info@secretmission.games.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Mad King Redemption wins the second prize at the Very Big Indie Pitch!
notes.content:
[b]Mad King Redemption[/b] just won 2nd place at the [i]Very Big Indie Pitch[/i] event during #DubaiGameExpoSummit, the biggest ever gaming event in Dubai – and we couldn't be happier.

We had the chance to showcase our game to the world, with extensive playtesting sessions that lasted two full days with gamers, journalists, investors and industry experts from all over the world. And Yes, we brought an arcade stick to play the game!

We landed in Dubai as a "Secret Mission", literally, but what we found was a vibrant community, warm connections, and a city that made us feel welcome from the very start. We met so many amazing people, had conversations that will stay with us for a long time, and returned home inspired (and slightly sunburnt).

Huge thanks to the whole Pocket Gamer Connects and #SteelMedia team – you made it all run so smoothly, and thanks to everyone who stopped by our booth, played our game with love, shared a connection, exchanged a laugh, or simply showed interest in what we’re building. More info about the event can be found at this URL:[url=https://www.pocketgamer.biz/biggest-ever-dubai-gameexpo-summit-draws-over-1400-game-professionals-from-70-countries-to-engage-with-the-vibrant-mena-games-market/]link[/url]

The success of our game starts with you. We are looking forward to sharing some exciting news as soon  as they become official; in the meantime we can confirm that a public demo is in the works, an announcement will arrive soon!

Don't forget to join our Discord Channel, and share this news with anyone who might be interested in our game - at this stage, it means everything to us.

Stay tuned folks!
